#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, sys, time, uuid, urllib.request, urllib.error
import jsonschema

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
C = json.load(open('/workspace/contracts/openapi.contract.json'))

# build a resolver for $refs
resolver = jsonschema.RefResolver.from_schema(C)

FAILS = []
def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)
        print("FAIL:", msg)

def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None, validate=True):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
        status = resp.status
        payload = json.loads(resp.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status = e.code
        payload = json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')
    if expect is not None:
        check(status == expect, f"{method} {path} -> {status}, expected {expect}: {json.dumps(payload)[:300]}")
    # validate against contract
    if validate:
        pkey = path
        for p in C['paths']:
            if '{' in p:
                import re
                rx = '^' + re.sub(r'\{[^}]+\}', '[^/]+', p) + '$'
                if re.match(pkey and rx, path):
                    pkey = p
                    break
        ops = C['paths'].get(pkey, {})
        op = ops.get(method.lower())
        if op:
            rspec = op['responses'].get(str(status)) or op['responses'].get('default')
            if rspec and 'content' in rspec:
                schema = rspec['content']['application/json']['schema']
                try:
                    jsonschema.validate(payload, schema, resolver=resolver)
                except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
                    FAILS.append(f"schema {method} {path} [{status}]: {e.message} at {list(e.path)}")
                    print("SCHEMA FAIL:", method, path, status, e.message, list(e.path))
                    print("  payload:", json.dumps(payload)[:400])
    return status, payload

# ---------- login ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {"username": "admin", "password": "admin123"}, expect=200)
admin = r['data']['sessionToken']
st, r = call('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {"username": "admin", "password": "wrong"}, expect=401)
check(r.get('error') is not None and r.get('code') == 'invalid_credentials', f"login error envelope: {r}")

# ---------- sample types ----------
st, types = call('POST', '/api/read-serviceability-snapshot', {}, token=admin, expect=200)
# get sample type ids from snapshot? use operations state instead
st, ops = call('POST', '/api/read-operations-state', {}, token=admin, expect=200)
stypes = ops['data']['sampleTypes'] if 'data' in ops else ops['sampleTypes']
byname = {t['name']: t for t in stypes}
amber = byname['Amber']['sampleTypeId']
print("sample types:", list(byname))

# ---------- locations ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-location', {
    "name": "Central Collection", "coordinate": {"latitude": 51.5, "longitude": -0.12},
    "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_hub"]}, token=admin, expect=201)
node1 = r['data']['locationId'] if 'data' in r else r['locationId']
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-location', {
    "name": "Main Lab", "coordinate": {"latitude": 51.51, "longitude": -0.1},
    "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, token=admin, expect=201)
lab1 = r['data']['locationId'] if 'data' in r else r['locationId']

st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-connection', {
    "fromLocationId": node1, "toLocationId": lab1, "travelMinutes": 30, "costUnits": 1, "active": True},
    token=admin, expect=201)
conn1 = r['data']['connectionId'] if 'data' in r else r['connectionId']

call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": node1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": lab1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": conn1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance', {"laboratoryId": lab1, "sampleTypeId": amber, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)

# ---------- users ----------
def mkuser(u, roles, quals=None, loc=None):
    body = {"username": u, "initialPassword": "pass12345", "roles": roles, "active": True,
            "fullName": u.title(), "email": u + "@x.io"}
    if quals: body["qualifications"] = quals
    if loc: body["assignedLocationId"] = loc
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-user', body, token=admin, expect=201)
    uid = r['data']['userId'] if 'data' in r else r['userId']
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {"username": u, "password": "pass12345"}, expect=200)
    return uid, r['data']['sessionToken']

req_id, req_tok = mkuser("req1", ["requester"])
pro_id, pro_tok = mkuser("pro1", ["collection_pro"], quals=["amber_collector"])
cou_id, cou_tok = mkuser("cou1", ["delivery_partner"])
nh_id, nh_tok = mkuser("nh1", ["node_handler"], loc=node1)
lo_id, lo_tok = mkuser("lo1", ["laboratory_team"], loc=lab1)

# role select
st, r = call('POST', '/api/select-active-role', {"role": "requester"}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/select-active-role', {"role": "dispatcher"}, token=req_tok, expect=403)

# ---------- serviceability ----------
home = {"latitude": 51.505, "longitude": -0.12}
st, r = call('POST', '/api/check-serviceability', {
    "origin": home, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": amber,
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2030-01-02T00:00:00Z"}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
check(d.get('serviceable') is True, f"serviceability: {r}")

# unserviceable: far away
st, r = call('POST', '/api/check-serviceability', {
    "origin": {"latitude": 40.0, "longitude": -0.12}, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": amber,
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2030-01-02T00:00:00Z"}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
check(d.get('serviceable') is False, f"far serviceability should be false: {r}")

# ---------- create request ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-collection-request', {
    "origin": home, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": amber,
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2030-01-02T00:00:00Z", "idempotencyKey": str(uuid.uuid4())},
    token=req_tok, expect=201)
d = r.get('data', r)
sample_id = d['sampleId']; journey_id = d['journeyId']; request_id = d['requestId']
print("sample:", sample_id, "journey:", journey_id)

# read sample state
st, r = call('GET', f'/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}', token=req_tok, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-sample-lifecycle', {"sampleId": sample_id}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=req_tok, expect=200)

# ---------- collection pro work ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
items = d.get('items', [])
coll_asg = None
for it in items:
    if it.get('assignmentId') and it.get('kind', '').startswith('collection') or it.get('assignmentType') == 'collection':
        coll_asg = it['assignmentId']
if not coll_asg and items:
    coll_asg = items[0].get('assignmentId')
check(coll_asg is not None, f"no collection assignment offered: {json.dumps(items)[:400]}")

if coll_asg:
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": coll_asg}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/record-worker-location', {"coordinate": home}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/collect-and-seal-sample', {
        "assignmentId": coll_asg, "collectedAt": "2030-01-01T09:00:00Z",
        "containerType": "standard", "temperatureC": 5.0}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
    print("collected:", json.dumps(r)[:200])

    # find courier assignment for leg home->node1
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
    d = r.get('data', r)
    items = d.get('items', [])
    leg1 = items[0]['assignmentId'] if items else None
    check(leg1 is not None, f"no courier assignment: {json.dumps(items)[:300]}")
    if leg1:
        call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": leg1}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        # handoff pro -> courier
        st, r = call('POST', '/api/initiate-handoff', {"assignmentId": leg1}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
        d = r.get('data', r)
        hid = d.get('handoffId')
        if hid:
            call('POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {"handoffId": hid}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
            call('POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {"handoffId": hid}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        # courier progress + delivery handoff to node handler
        call('POST', '/api/update-assignment-progress', {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "en_route"}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        call('POST', '/api/record-worker-location', {"coordinate": {"latitude": 51.5, "longitude": -0.12}}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)

        # node handler work
        st, r = call('POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, token=nh_tok, expect=200)
        print("nh work:", json.dumps(r)[:300])

# ---------- dispatcher views ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-operations-state', {}, token=admin, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/search-audit-trail', {"entityId": sample_id}, token=admin, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
check('entries' in d, f"audit entries missing: {json.dumps(d)[:200]}")
print("audit entries:", d.get('total'))

print()
print("FAILURES:", len(FAILS))
for f in FAILS:
    print(" -", f)
sys.exit(1 if FAILS else 0)

FAILS = []
def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)
        print("FAIL:", msg)

def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None, validate=True):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
        status = resp.status
        payload = json.loads(resp.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status = e.code
        payload = json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')
    if expect is not None:
        check(status == expect, f"{method} {path} -> {status}, expected {expect}: {json.dumps(payload)[:300]}")
    # validate against contract
    if validate:
        pkey = path
        for p in C['paths']:
            if '{' in p:
                import re
                rx = '^' + re.sub(r'\{[^}]+\}', '[^/]+', p) + '$'
                if re.match(pkey and rx, path):
                    pkey = p
                    break
        ops = C['paths'].get(pkey, {})
        op = ops.get(method.lower())
        if op:
            rspec = op['responses'].get(str(status)) or op['responses'].get('default')
            if rspec and 'content' in rspec:
                schema = rspec['content']['application/json']['schema']
                try:
                    jsonschema.validate(payload, schema, resolver=resolver)
                except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
                    FAILS.append(f"schema {method} {path} [{status}]: {e.message} at {list(e.path)}")
                    print("SCHEMA FAIL:", method, path, status, e.message, list(e.path))
                    print("  payload:", json.dumps(payload)[:400])
    return status, payload

admin = r['data']['sessionToken']

call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": lab1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": conn1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance', {"laboratoryId": lab1, "sampleTypeId": amber, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)

# ---------- users ----------
def mkuser(u, roles, quals=None, loc=None):
    body = {"username": u, "initialPassword": "pass12345", "roles": roles, "active": True,

st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=req_tok, expect=200)

# ---------- collection pro work ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
items = d.get('items', [])
coll_asg = None
for it in items:

        coll_asg = it['assignmentId']
if not coll_asg and items:

    url = BASE + path

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, re, sys, uuid, urllib.request, urllib.error
import jsonschema

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:8080"
C = json.load(open('/workspace/contracts/openapi.contract.json'))
resolver = jsonschema.RefResolver.from_schema(C)

FAILS = []
def check(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        FAILS.append(msg)
        print("FAIL:", msg)

def call(method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=None, validate=True):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    try:
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req)
        status = resp.status
        payload = json.loads(resp.read() or b'{}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        status = e.code
        payload = json.loads(e.read() or b'{}')
    if expect is not None:
        check(status == expect, f"{method} {path} -> {status}, expected {expect}: {json.dumps(payload)[:300]}")
    if validate:
        pkey = path
        for p in C['paths']:
            if '{' in p:
                rx = '^' + re.sub(r'\{[^}]+\}', '[^/]+', p) + '$'
                if re.match(rx, path):
                    pkey = p
                    break
        op = C['paths'].get(pkey, {}).get(method.lower())
        if op:
            rspec = op['responses'].get(str(status)) or op['responses'].get('default')
            if rspec and 'content' in rspec:
                schema = rspec['content']['application/json']['schema']
                try:
                    jsonschema.validate(payload, schema, resolver=resolver)
                except jsonschema.ValidationError as e:
                    FAILS.append(f"schema {method} {path} [{status}]: {e.message} at {list(e.path)}")
                    print("SCHEMA FAIL:", method, path, status, e.message, list(e.path))
                    print("  payload:", json.dumps(payload)[:400])
    return status, payload

def idem():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

NOW = "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z"

# ---------- login ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {"username": "admin", "password": "admin123"}, expect=200)
admin = r['data']['sessionToken']
st, r = call('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {"username": "admin", "password": "wrong"}, expect=401)
check(r.get('code') == 'invalid_credentials', f"login error envelope: {r}")

# ---------- sample type ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-sample-type', {
    "name": "Smoke", "containerType": "standard", "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25,
    "qualifiedCollectorRequired": True, "requiredQualification": "smoke_collector",
    "batchingAllowed": True}, token=admin, expect=201)
stype = r['data']['sampleTypeId']

# ---------- locations ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-location', {
    "name": "Central Collection", "coordinate": {"latitude": 51.5, "longitude": -0.12},
    "active": True, "functions": ["collection_point", "transfer_hub"]}, token=admin, expect=201)
node1 = r['data']['locationId']
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-location', {
    "name": "Main Lab", "coordinate": {"latitude": 51.51, "longitude": -0.1},
    "active": True, "functions": ["laboratory"]}, token=admin, expect=201)
lab1 = r['data']['locationId']

st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-connection', {
    "fromLocationId": node1, "toLocationId": lab1, "travelMinutes": 30, "costUnits": 1, "active": True},
    token=admin, expect=201)
conn1 = r['data']['connectionId']

call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": node1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": lab1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-capacity', {"resourceId": conn1, "capacityUnits": 10, "cooledCapacityUnits": 5}, token=admin, expect=200)
call('POST', '/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance', {"laboratoryId": lab1, "sampleTypeId": stype, "accepts": True}, token=admin, expect=200)

# ---------- users ----------
def mkuser(u, roles, quals=None, loc=None):
    body = {"username": u, "initialPassword": "pass12345", "roles": roles, "active": True,
            "fullName": u.title(), "email": u + "@x.io"}
    if quals: body["qualifications"] = quals
    if loc: body["assignedLocationId"] = loc
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-user', body, token=admin, expect=201)
    uid = r['data']['userId']
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {"username": u, "password": "pass12345"}, expect=200)
    return uid, r['data']['sessionToken']

req_id, req_tok = mkuser("req1", ["requester"])
pro_id, pro_tok = mkuser("pro1", ["collection_pro"], quals=["smoke_collector"])
cou_id, cou_tok = mkuser("cou1", ["delivery_partner"])
nh_id, nh_tok = mkuser("nh1", ["node_handler"], loc=node1)
lo_id, lo_tok = mkuser("lo1", ["laboratory_team"], loc=lab1)

st, r = call('POST', '/api/select-active-role', {"role": "requester"}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/select-active-role', {"role": "dispatcher"}, token=req_tok, expect=403)

# ---------- serviceability ----------
home = {"latitude": 51.505, "longitude": -0.12}
st, r = call('POST', '/api/check-serviceability', {
    "origin": home, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": stype, "requestedAt": NOW,
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2030-01-02T00:00:00Z"}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
check(d.get('serviceable') is True, f"serviceability: {r}")

st, r = call('POST', '/api/check-serviceability', {
    "origin": {"latitude": 40.0, "longitude": -0.12}, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": stype,
    "requestedAt": NOW,
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2030-01-02T00:00:00Z"}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
d = r.get('data', r)
check(d.get('serviceable') is False, f"far serviceability should be false: {r}")

# snapshot
st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-serviceability-snapshot', {}, token=req_tok, expect=200)

# ---------- create request ----------
st, r = call('POST', '/api/create-collection-request', {
    "origin": home, "originType": "home", "sampleTypeId": stype, "requestedAt": NOW,
    "earliestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T08:00:00Z", "latestCollectionAt": "2030-01-01T12:00:00Z",
    "deliveryDeadline": "2030-01-02T00:00:00Z", "containerType": "standard",
    "temperatureMinC": 2, "temperatureMaxC": 25, "idempotencyKey": idem()},
    token=req_tok, expect=201)
d = r.get('data', r)
sample_id = d['sampleId']; journey_id = d['journeyId']; request_id = d['requestId']
print("sample:", sample_id, "journey:", journey_id)

st, r = call('GET', f'/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}', token=req_tok, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-sample-lifecycle', {"sampleId": sample_id}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
st, r = call('POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {"journeyId": journey_id}, token=req_tok, expect=200)

# requester sees only own requests
st, r = call('POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, token=req_tok, expect=200)
d = r['data']
check(any(i.get('sampleId') == sample_id for i in d['pending'] + d['inProgress']), "requester work missing sample")

# ---------- collection pro ----------
def find_item(tok, kind, status_list=('pending', 'inProgress')):
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, token=tok, expect=200)
    d = r['data']
    for sect in status_list:
        for it in d[sect]:
            if it.get('kind') == kind:
                return it
    return None

it = find_item(pro_tok, 'collection')
check(it is not None, "no collection work offered to pro")
coll_asg = it['assignmentId'] if it else None

if coll_asg:
    # wrong user cannot accept
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": coll_asg, "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=403)
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": coll_asg, "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/record-worker-location', {"assignmentId": coll_asg, "coordinate": home, "sequence": 1, "recordedAt": "2030-01-01T08:30:00Z"}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
    st, r = call('POST', '/api/collect-and-seal-sample', {
        "sampleId": sample_id, "assignmentId": coll_asg, "collectedAt": "2030-01-01T09:00:00Z",
        "containerType": "standard", "observedTemperatureC": 5.0, "idempotencyKey": idem()},
        token=pro_tok, expect=200)
    print("collected:", json.dumps(r)[:200])

    # ---------- courier leg ----------
    it = find_item(cou_tok, 'transport')
    check(it is not None, "no transport work offered to courier")
    leg1 = it['assignmentId'] if it else None
    if leg1:
        call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": leg1, "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        st, r = call('POST', '/api/initiate-handoff', {
            "sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": coll_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg1,
            "receiverId": cou_id, "initiatedAt": "2030-01-01T09:05:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()},
            token=pro_tok, expect=200)
        hid = r['data']['handoffId']
        call('POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {"handoffId": hid, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": "2030-01-01T09:06:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=pro_tok, expect=200)
        st, r = call('POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {"handoffId": hid, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": "2030-01-01T09:07:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        # custody now with courier
        st, r = call('GET', f'/api/read-sample-state/{sample_id}', token=req_tok, expect=200)
        d = r['data']
        check(d.get('currentHolderId') == cou_id, f"holder after handoff: {d.get('currentHolderId')} != {cou_id}")

        call('POST', '/api/update-assignment-progress', {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "in_transit", "occurredAt": "2030-01-01T09:10:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        call('POST', '/api/record-worker-location', {"assignmentId": leg1, "coordinate": {"latitude": 51.5, "longitude": -0.12}, "sequence": 2, "recordedAt": "2030-01-01T09:20:00Z"}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
        call('POST', '/api/update-assignment-progress', {"assignmentId": leg1, "status": "arrived", "occurredAt": "2030-01-01T09:30:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)

        # handling checkpoint in range
        call('POST', '/api/record-handling-checkpoint', {"sampleId": sample_id, "containerType": "standard", "observedTemperatureC": 6.0, "observedAt": "2030-01-01T09:15:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)

        # ---------- node handler ----------
        it = find_item(nh_tok, 'node')
        check(it is not None, "no node work offered to handler")
        node_asg = it['assignmentId'] if it else None
        if node_asg:
            call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": node_asg, "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=nh_tok, expect=200)
            st, r = call('POST', '/api/initiate-handoff', {
                "sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": leg1, "toAssignmentId": node_asg,
                "receiverId": nh_id, "initiatedAt": "2030-01-01T09:32:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()},
                token=cou_tok, expect=200)
            hid = r['data']['handoffId']
            call('POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {"handoffId": hid, "confirmationSide": "sender", "confirmedAt": "2030-01-01T09:33:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
            call('POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {"handoffId": hid, "confirmationSide": "receiver", "confirmedAt": "2030-01-01T09:34:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=nh_tok, expect=200)

            # ---------- second courier leg node->lab ----------
            it = find_item(cou_tok, 'transport')
            check(it is not None, "no second transport leg offered")
            leg2 = it['assignmentId'] if it else None
            if leg2:
                call('POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {"assignmentId": leg2, "idempotencyKey": idem()}, token=cou_tok, expect=200)
                st, r = call('POST', '/api/initiate-handoff', {
                    "sampleId": sample_id, "fromAssignmentId": node_asg, "toAssignmentId": leg2,
                    "receiverId": cou_id, "initiatedAt": "2030-01-01T09:40:00Z", "idempotencyKey": idem()},

# Lab Sample Pickup & Delivery System

Clinical samples may start at a patient’s home, a clinic, or a collection point and must reach a suitable laboratory before their delivery deadline.

Home samples must be collected and sealed by a certified collection professional before they can enter the transport network. Once sealed, a sample may pass through relay couriers, collection centres and hubs before reaching the laboratory.

Dispatchers currently coordinate much of this work through calls, chat groups, and spreadsheets. This makes it difficult to track custody, use available capacity, assign work fairly, combine compatible samples, and recover when part of the network becomes unavailable.

Build a web application that manages this entire process, from the initial serviceability check through laboratory receipt.

## Users and responsibilities

Use role-based access control for both actions and data: each user may perform actions and see data only as permitted by the role or roles they currently hold.

For each of their roles, a user can see their current work and their past (completed) work, and can view a status timeline — the ordered history of status changes — for every item of work they are responsible for.

A user may have more than one assigned role:

- The user must explicitly select the role they are currently working under, and permissions and work views must use that selected role.
- Switching role context must not add or remove any roles from the account.

### Requester

A requester should be able to:

- Check whether a location and sample can be serviced before creating a request.
- Create a home or clinic collection request.
- Follow the sample’s current status, location, route and history.
- See only requests that belong to them.

The serviceability check must be a dry run. It must not create a request, sample, journey, assignment or capacity reservation.

### Certified collection professional

A certified collection professional should be able to:

- View collection work for which they are qualified.
- Accept or decline an offered collection assignment.
- Record that a sample was collected and sealed.
- Record their current location.
- Hand off and confirm the transfer of the sealed sample to a relay courier or facility.

### Relay courier

A relay courier should be able to:

- View delivery work assigned to them.
- Accept or decline an offered transport assignment.
- See only the details needed for their assigned leg.
- Record location and progress updates.
- Confirm pickup and handoff with the other party.

### Node handler

A node handler should be able to:

- Accept or decline an offered node assignment.
- Manage samples arriving at and leaving a collection centre or hub.
- Register a sample that was already collected and sealed before entering the system.
- Confirm incoming and outgoing handoffs.
- View and configure regular and cooled capacity at the node they are assigned to.

### Laboratory intake operator

A laboratory intake operator should be able to:

- Accept or decline an offered laboratory assignment.
- View expected samples and configure regular and cooled capacity at the laboratory they are assigned to.
- Confirm that a sample was received.
- Record an exception when a sample cannot be accepted normally.

### Dispatcher

A dispatcher should be able to:

- Monitor samples, workers, collection nodes, laboratories, routes and exceptions.
- See the current holder of each sample and whether its latest location is stale.
- View the full journey, including collection and individual transport legs.
- Change, split, merge, cancel or reroute unfinished work.
- Replan unfinished work when a worker, node, route, laboratory or capacity pool becomes unavailable.
- Search the complete audit history of a request or sample.

Completed work and confirmed custody must not be rewritten during replanning.

### Administrator

An administrator may also do everything a dispatcher can do.

In addition, only an administrator can:

- Manage users, roles and professional certifications, including which node or laboratory a node handler or laboratory intake operator is assigned to.
- Create and update collection nodes and laboratories.
- Create and update sample types and their handling attributes.
- Activate or deactivate a location, an individual function it provides, or a connection, without restarting the application.
- Configure service coverage, travel times, handling times and laboratory capabilities.
- Configure regular and cooled capacity for any node, laboratory, or transport connection.

## Collection requests

A collection request records where and when a sample can be collected and when it must reach the laboratory:

- **Origin** — a patient’s home, a clinic, or a network node.
- **Sample type** — see Sample types below.
- **Collection window** — the earliest and latest time at which the sample may be collected. Collection must take place inside this window.
- **Delivery deadline** — the time by which the sample must be received at the laboratory.

The collection window and the delivery deadline are separate constraints: the window governs when pickup may happen, the deadline governs when laboratory receipt must happen. A plan is valid only when collection takes place within the collection window and the sample can still reach an accepting laboratory before its delivery deadline.

## Pre-sealed samples

A certified collection professional, relay courier, node handler, or laboratory intake operator may register a sample that was already collected and sealed before entering the system — the person registering it must be the one who currently holds it.

- Its origin must be a clinic or a network node — not a home.
- The system should create only the transport legs needed from the point of registration onward.

## Sample types

Every sample has a type that determines its handling rules, and those rules apply for the whole journey, from collection through laboratory receipt. The system must have at least the following named types available by default: Amber, Indigo, Frost, Pulse. Each of the four requires a qualified collector — only a certified collection professional holding the matching qualification may collect it.

- **Amber** — standard handling.

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'

def call(path, body=None, token=None, method='POST'):
    cmd = ['curl', '-s', '-X', method, f'{BASE}{path}', '-H', 'Content-Type: application/json']
    if token:
        cmd += ['-H', f'Authorization: Bearer {token}']
    if body is not None:
        cmd += ['-d', json.dumps(body)]
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        return json.loads(r.stdout)
    except Exception:
        return {'_raw': r.stdout}

def login(u, p):
    r = call('/api/authenticate-user', {'username': u, 'password': p})
    return r['data']['sessionToken']

admin = login('admin', 'admin123')
print('admin login OK')

ops = call('/api/read-operations-state', {}, admin)
data = ops.get('data', {})
print('ops keys:', sorted(data.keys())[:20])
sts = data.get('sampleTypes') or data.get('sample_types') or []
print('sample types:', [(t.get('name'), t.get('sampleTypeId') or t.get('id')) for t in sts])
amber = next((t for t in sts if t.get('name') == 'Amber'), None)
amber_id = amber.get('sampleTypeId') or amber.get('id')

# locations
loc1 = call('/api/create-location', {
    'name': 'Indiranagar Collection Centre', 'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9719, 'longitude': 77.6412},
    'active': True, 'functions': ['collection_point', 'transfer_point', 'hub']}, admin)
print('loc1:', json.dumps(loc1)[:250])
lab = call('/api/create-location', {
    'name': 'Central Lab', 'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9352, 'longitude': 77.6245},
    'active': True, 'functions': ['laboratory']}, admin)
print('lab:', json.dumps(lab)[:250])

def get_id(resp, *keys):
    d = resp.get('data', resp)
    for k in keys:
        if k in d:
            return d[k]
    return None

loc1_id = get_id(loc1, 'locationId', 'id')
lab_id = get_id(lab, 'locationId', 'id')
print('ids:', loc1_id, lab_id)

# lab acceptance
acc = call('/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance', {'laboratoryId': lab_id, 'sampleTypeId': amber_id, 'accepts': True}, admin)
print('accept:', json.dumps(acc)[:200])

# connection
conn = call('/api/create-connection', {'fromLocationId': loc1_id, 'toLocationId': lab_id, 'travelMinutes': 25, 'costUnits': 1, 'active': True}, admin)
print('conn:', json.dumps(conn)[:250])

# capacity on lab + node
cap1 = call('/api/configure-capacity', {'targetType': 'location', 'targetId': lab_id, 'regularUnits': 10, 'cooledUnits': 5}, admin)
print('cap lab:', json.dumps(cap1)[:200])

# requester user
u = call('/api/create-user', {'username': 'req1', 'initialPassword': 'pass1234', 'roles': ['requester'], 'active': True, 'fullName': 'Rita Requester'}, admin)
print('user:', json.dumps(u)[:250])

req_tok = login('req1', 'pass1234')
print('requester login OK')

now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
svc = call('/api/check-serviceability', {
    'origin': {'latitude': 12.9720, 'longitude': 77.6410}, 'originType': 'home',
    'sampleTypeId': amber_id, 'requestedAt': now.isoformat(),
    'earliestCollectionAt': now.isoformat(),
    'latestCollectionAt': (now + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).isoformat(),
    'deliveryDeadline': (now + datetime.timedelta(hours=8)).isoformat()}, req_tok)
print('serviceability:', json.dumps(svc)[:400])

creq = call('/api/create-collection-request', {
    'origin': {'latitude': 12.9720, 'longitude': 77.6410}, 'originType': 'home',
    'sampleTypeId': amber_id, 'requestedAt': now.isoformat(),
    'earliestCollectionAt': now.isoformat(),
    'latestCollectionAt': (now + datetime.timedelta(hours=2)).isoformat(),
    'deliveryDeadline': (now + datetime.timedelta(hours=8)).isoformat()}, req_tok)
print('create request:', json.dumps(creq)[:500])

import os, sys, json, subprocess, datetime
os.environ.setdefault('PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH', '/tmp/ms-playwright')
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'

def call(path, body=None, token=None, method='POST'):
    cmd = ['curl', '-s', '-X', method, f'{BASE}{path}', '-H', 'Content-Type: application/json']
    if token: cmd += ['-H', f'Authorization: Bearer {token}']
    if body is not None: cmd += ['-d', json.dumps(body)]
    return json.loads(subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)

results = []
def check(name, cond, extra=''):
    results.append((name, bool(cond), extra))
    print(('PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'), name, extra)

# API-side setup: requester with a sample
req_tok = call('/api/authenticate-user', {'username': 'req1', 'password': 'pass1234'})['data']['sessionToken']
work = call('/api/list-role-work', {}, req_tok)['data']
sample_id = None
for it in work.get('pending', []) + work.get('inProgress', []) + work.get('completed', []):
    if it.get('sampleId'):
        sample_id = it['sampleId']
        break
print('using sample', sample_id)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()

    # 1. login_rejects_invalid_credentials
    page.goto(BASE)
    page.fill('#username', 'req1')
    page.fill('#password', 'wrongpass')
    page.click('button[type=submit]')
    page.wait_for_selector('.alert.error', timeout=5000)
    msg = page.inner_text('.alert.error')
    check('login_rejects_invalid_credentials', 'invalid' in msg.lower(), msg)
    # still on login page
    check('login_rejects_stays_on_login', page.query_selector('#username') is not None)

    # valid login as requester
    page.fill('#password', 'pass1234')
    page.click('button[type=submit]')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=My work', timeout=8000)
    check('login_valid_requester', True)

    # 4. role_work_view_shows_current_and_past
    body = page.inner_text('body')
    check('work_view_sections', 'Current work' in body and 'Past work' in body and 'Pending offers' in body)

    # 5/6. sample view: ordered status history, freshness, location/custodian/progress
    if sample_id:
        page.goto(f'{BASE}/samples/{sample_id}')
        page.wait_for_selector('text=Status history', timeout=8000)
        body = page.inner_text('body')
        check('sample_view_history', 'Status history' in body)
        check('sample_freshness_visible', 'Location freshness' in body and ('stale' in body or 'fresh' in body))
        check('sample_view_custodian', 'Current custodian' in body)
        check('sample_view_location', 'Current / last known location' in body)
        check('sample_view_progress', 'Route progress' in body)
        # timeline ordered: timestamps non-decreasing
        times = page.eval_on_selector_all(
            '.timeline time, [data-occurred-at]',
            'els => els.map(e => e.getAttribute("datetime") || e.getAttribute("data-occurred-at"))')
        # fallback: check at least one timeline entry rendered
        entries = page.query_selector_all('.timeline li, .timeline .entry, ol li')
        check('sample_timeline_has_entries', len(entries) >= 1, f'{len(entries)} entries')
    page.click('text=Sign out')

    # 2. role_switch_control_lists_and_applies_role
    page.wait_for_selector('#username', timeout=5000)
    page.fill('#username', 'multi1')
    page.fill('#password', 'pass1234')
    page.click('button[type=submit]')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=Select your working role', timeout=8000)
    radios = page.query_selector_all('input[name=active-role]')
    check('role_selection_lists_roles', len(radios) == 2, f'{len(radios)} roles')
    page.check('input[name=active-role][value=requester]')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=My work', timeout=8000)
    body = page.inner_text('body')
    check('role_applied_requester', 'New request' in body and 'Monitor' not in body)
    # switch via the role-switch control
    page.select_option('#role-switch', 'dispatcher')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=Monitor', timeout=8000)
    body = page.inner_text('body')
    check('role_switch_applies_dispatcher', 'Monitor' in body and 'New request' not in body)
    sel = page.eval_on_selector('#role-switch', 'e => e.value')
    check('role_switch_value', sel == 'dispatcher', sel)

    # 7. map on monitor page (offline assets)
    failed_assets = []
    page.on('response', lambda r: failed_assets.append(r.url) if ('/map-assets/' in r.url and r.status >= 400) else None)
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/monitor')
    page.wait_for_selector('.maplibregl-canvas, canvas', timeout=10000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    check('monitor_map_canvas', page.query_selector('canvas') is not None)
    check('map_assets_no_failures', len(failed_assets) == 0, str(failed_assets[:3]))

    browser.close()

print()
fails = [r for r in results if not r[1]]
print(f'{len(results)-len(fails)}/{len(results)} passed')
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)

os.environ.setdefault('PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH', '/tmp/ms-playwright')
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'

def call(path, body=None, token=None, method='POST'):
    cmd = ['curl', '-s', '-X', method, f'{BASE}{path}', '-H', 'Content-Type: application/json']
    if token: cmd += ['-H', f'Authorization: Bearer {token}']
    if body is not None: cmd += ['-d', json.dumps(body)]
    return json.loads(subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout)

results = []
def check(name, cond, extra=''):
    results.append((name, bool(cond), extra))
    print(('PASS' if cond else 'FAIL'), name, extra)

# API-side setup: requester with a sample
req_tok = call('/api/authenticate-user', {'username': 'req1', 'password': 'pass1234'})['data']['sessionToken']
work = call('/api/list-role-work', {}, req_tok)['data']
sample_id = None
for it in work.get('pending', []) + work.get('inProgress', []) + work.get('completed', []):
    if it.get('sampleId'):
        sample_id = it['sampleId']
        break
print('using sample', sample_id)

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch()
    page = browser.new_page()

    # 1. login_rejects_invalid_credentials
    page.goto(BASE)
    page.fill('#username', 'req1')
    page.fill('#password', 'wrongpass')
    page.click('button[type=submit]')
    page.wait_for_selector('.alert.error', timeout=5000)
    msg = page.inner_text('.alert.error')
    check('login_rejects_invalid_credentials', 'invalid' in msg.lower(), msg)
    # still on login page
    check('login_rejects_stays_on_login', page.query_selector('#username') is not None)

    # valid login as requester
    page.fill('#password', 'pass1234')
    page.click('button[type=submit]')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=My work', timeout=8000)
    check('login_valid_requester', True)

    # 4. role_work_view_shows_current_and_past
    body = page.inner_text('body')
    check('work_view_sections', 'Current work' in body and 'Past work' in body and 'Pending offers' in body)

    # 5/6. sample view: ordered status history, freshness, location/custodian/progress
    if sample_id:
        page.goto(f'{BASE}/samples/{sample_id}')
        page.wait_for_selector('text=Status history', timeout=8000)
        body = page.inner_text('body')
        check('sample_view_history', 'Status history' in body)
        check('sample_freshness_visible', 'Location freshness' in body and ('stale' in body or 'fresh' in body))
        check('sample_view_custodian', 'Current custodian' in body)
        check('sample_view_location', 'Current / last known location' in body)
        check('sample_view_progress', 'Route progress' in body)
        # timeline ordered: timestamps non-decreasing
        times = page.eval_on_selector_all(
            '.timeline time, [data-occurred-at]',
            'els => els.map(e => e.getAttribute("datetime") || e.getAttribute("data-occurred-at"))')
        # fallback: check at least one timeline entry rendered
        entries = page.query_selector_all('.timeline li, .timeline .entry, ol li')
        check('sample_timeline_has_entries', len(entries) >= 1, f'{len(entries)} entries')
    page.click('text=Sign out')

    # 2. role_switch_control_lists_and_applies_role
    page.wait_for_selector('#username', timeout=5000)
    page.fill('#username', 'multi1')
    page.fill('#password', 'pass1234')
    page.click('button[type=submit]')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=Select your working role', timeout=8000)
    radios = page.query_selector_all('input[name=active-role]')
    check('role_selection_lists_roles', len(radios) == 2, f'{len(radios)} roles')
    page.check('input[name=active-role][value=requester]')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=My work', timeout=8000)
    body = page.inner_text('body')
    check('role_applied_requester', 'New request' in body and 'Monitor' not in body)
    # switch via the role-switch control
    page.select_option('#role-switch', 'dispatcher')
    page.wait_for_selector('text=Monitor', timeout=8000)
    body = page.inner_text('body')
    check('role_switch_applies_dispatcher', 'Monitor' in body and 'New request' not in body)
    sel = page.eval_on_selector('#role-switch', 'e => e.value')
    check('role_switch_value', sel == 'dispatcher', sel)

    # 7. map on monitor page (offline assets)
    failed_assets = []
    page.on('response', lambda r: failed_assets.append(r.url) if ('/map-assets/' in r.url and r.status >= 400) else None)
    page.goto(f'{BASE}/monitor')
    page.wait_for_selector('.maplibregl-canvas, canvas', timeout=10000)
    page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    check('monitor_map_canvas', page.query_selector('canvas') is not None)
    check('map_assets_no_failures', len(failed_assets) == 0, str(failed_assets[:3]))

    browser.close()

print()
fails = [r for r in results if not r[1]]
print(f'{len(results)-len(fails)}/{len(results)} passed')
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)

"""End-to-end verification of all 45 pinned contract operations."""
import json, time, uuid, datetime, urllib.request, urllib.error, sys

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
results = []
covered = set()

def now_iso():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def plus(h):
    return (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(hours=h)).isoformat()

def ikey():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or '{}'), {}
        except Exception:
            return e.code, {}, {}

def check(opid, ok, detail=''):
    covered.add(opid)
    results.append((opid, ok, detail))
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), opid, detail[:200])
    return ok

def op(opid, method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=200, field=None):
    st, resp, _ = raw(method, path, body, token)
    ok = st == expect and ('data' in resp or expect >= 400)
    if expect < 400:
        ok = st == expect and 'data' in resp
    check(opid, ok, f'HTTP {st}')
    if not ok:
        print('   resp:', json.dumps(resp)[:300])
        raise SystemExit(f'{opid} failed: {st} {json.dumps(resp)[:300]}')
    d = resp.get('data', {})
    return d

def login(username, password):
    st, resp, _ = raw('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {'username': username, 'password': password})
    assert st == 200, f'login {username} failed: {resp}'
    return resp['data']

   {'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, coll_tok)

    'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'],

    'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'status': 'at_pickup',

# ---------- 7. transport chain: collector -> courier(leg1) -> node -> courier(leg2) -> lab ----------
def do_handoff(sender_tok, receiver_tok, sample_id, from_asg, to_asg, receiver_id):
    h = op('initiate_handoff', 'POST', '/api/initiate-handoff', {
        'sampleId': sample_id, 'fromAssignmentId': from_asg, 'toAssignmentId': to_asg,
        'receiverId': receiver_id, 'initiatedAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, sender_tok, 201)
    hid = h['handoffId']
    op('confirm_handoff', 'POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {
        'handoffId': hid, 'confirmationSide': 'sender',
        'confirmedAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, sender_tok)
    rk = ikey()
    op('confirm_handoff', 'POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {
        'handoffId': hid, 'confirmationSide': 'receiver',
        'confirmedAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': rk}, receiver_tok)
    # idempotent replay of receiver confirmation must not duplicate custody
    op('confirm_handoff', 'POST', '/api/confirm-handoff', {
        'handoffId': hid, 'confirmationSide': 'receiver',
        'confirmedAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': rk}, receiver_tok)
    return hid

legs = wait_work(cour_tok, S1, 'transport')

d = op('list_role_work', 'POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, cour_tok)
leg_items = [it for sect in ('pending', 'inProgress') for it in d.get(sect, [])
             if it.get('sampleId') == S1 and it.get('kind') == 'transport']
leg_items.sort(key=lambda x: x.get('sequence', 0))
assert len(leg_items) == 2, f'expected 2 legs, got {len(leg_items)}'
leg1, leg2 = leg_items[0]['assignmentId'], leg_items[1]['assignmentId']

op('accept_assignment', 'POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {'assignmentId': leg1, 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, cour_tok)
do_handoff(coll_tok, cour_tok, S1, a_coll['assignmentId'], leg1, cour_id)

    op('update_assignment_progress', 'POST', '/api/update-assignment-progress', {
        'assignmentId': leg1, 'status': stt, 'occurredAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, cour_tok)

a_node = wait_work(node_tok, S1, 'node')
op('accept_assignment', 'POST', '/api/accept-assignment',
   {'assignmentId': a_node['assignmentId'], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, node_tok)
do_handoff(cour_tok, node_tok, S1, leg1, a_node['assignmentId'], node_id)

op('accept_assignment', 'POST', '/api/accept-assignment', {'assignmentId': leg2, 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, cour_tok)
do_handoff(node_tok, cour_tok, S1, a_node['assignmentId'], leg2, cour_id)
for stt in ('picked_up', 'in_transit', 'arrived'):
    op('update_assignment_progress', 'POST', '/api/update-assignment-progress', {
        'assignmentId': leg2, 'status': stt, 'occurredAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, cour_tok)

a_lab = wait_work(labop_tok, S1, 'laboratory')
op('accept_assignment', 'POST', '/api/accept-assignment',
   {'assignmentId': a_lab['assignmentId'], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, labop_tok)

op('confirm_laboratory_receipt', 'POST', '/api/confirm-laboratory-receipt', {

ss = op('read_sample_state', 'GET', f'/api/read-sample-state/{S1}', token=req_tok)
check('read_sample_state.received', ss.get('status') == 'received', ss.get('status', ''))
check('read_sample_state.custody', ss.get('currentHolderId') == labop_id, str(ss.get('currentHolderId')))
lc = op('read_sample_lifecycle', 'POST', '/api/read-sample-lifecycle', {'sampleId': S1}, req_tok)
ev = lc.get('events') or lc.get('timeline') or []
check('read_sample_lifecycle.entries', len(ev) >= 5, f'{len(ev)} entries')
op('read_journey_plan', 'POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {'journeyId': J1}, disp_tok)

# ---------- 8. dispatcher ops: merge / split / reroute / cancel / disruption ----------
r2 = mkrequest(); S2, J2 = r2['sampleId'], r2['journeyId']
r3 = mkrequest(); S3, J3 = r3['sampleId'], r3['journeyId']

plan = op('read_journey_plan', 'POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {'journeyId': J2}, disp_tok)
op('merge_journeys', 'POST', '/api/merge-journeys', {
    'targetJourneyId': J2, 'expectedPlanVersion': plan['planVersion'],
    'sourceJourneyIds': [J3], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, disp_tok, 201)

plan = op('read_journey_plan', 'POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {'journeyId': J2}, disp_tok)
check('merge_journeys.batched', len(plan.get('sampleIds', [])) == 2, str(plan.get('sampleIds')))
op('split_journey', 'POST', '/api/split-journey', {
    'journeyId': J2, 'expectedPlanVersion': plan['planVersion'],
    'sampleIds': [S3], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, disp_tok, 201)

plan = op('read_journey_plan', 'POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {'journeyId': J2}, disp_tok)
op('reroute_journey', 'POST', '/api/reroute-journey', {
    'journeyId': J2, 'expectedPlanVersion': plan['planVersion'],
    'reason': 'verify reroute', 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, disp_tok, 201)

# lab exception on S2 (still active)
op('record_laboratory_exception', 'POST', '/api/record-laboratory-exception', {
    'sampleId': S2, 'laboratoryId': lab_id, 'reason': 'verify exception handling',
    'observedAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, labop_tok, 201)

# cancel a fresh request's journey
r4 = mkrequest(); S4, J4 = r4['sampleId'], r4['journeyId']
plan = op('read_journey_plan', 'POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {'journeyId': J4}, disp_tok)
op('cancel_journey', 'POST', '/api/cancel-journey', {
    'journeyId': J4, 'expectedPlanVersion': plan['planVersion'],
    'reason': 'verify cancel', 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, disp_tok, 201)

# disruption report on the connection
op('report_disruption', 'POST', '/api/report-disruption', {
    'resourceType': 'connection', 'resourceId': conn_id,
    'reason': 'verify disruption', 'occurredAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, disp_tok, 201)
raw('POST', '/api/set-connection-status', {'connectionId': conn_id, 'active': True}, adm_tok)

# ---------- 9. pre-sealed ingest ----------
ps = op('ingest_presealed_sample', 'POST', '/api/ingest-presealed-sample', {
    'origin': {'latitude': 12.9721, 'longitude': 77.6411}, 'originType': 'clinic',
    'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'requestedAt': now_iso(),
    'deliveryDeadline': plus(8), 'containerType': 'standard',
    'temperatureMinC': 2, 'temperatureMaxC': 25, 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, coll_tok, 201)
check('ingest_presealed_sample.sealed', ps.get('alreadySealed') is True, str(ps.get('sampleId')))

# ---------- 10. monitoring ----------
aud = op('search_audit_trail', 'POST', '/api/search-audit-trail',
         {'entityId': S1, 'limit': 50}, disp_tok)
entries = aud.get('entries') or aud.get('records') or aud.get('results') or []
check('search_audit_trail.entries', len(entries) >= 5, f'{len(entries)} entries')
op('read_operations_state', 'POST', '/api/read-operations-state', {'filters': {}}, disp_tok)
snap = op('read_serviceability_snapshot', 'POST', '/api/read-serviceability-snapshot', {}, req_tok)

# list_role_work with status filter (past work)
w = op('list_role_work', 'POST', '/api/list-role-work', {'status': 'received'}, req_tok)
check('list_role_work.status_filter', any(i.get('sampleId') == S1 for i in w.get('completed', [])), 'S1 in completed')

# ---------- 11. realtime events (websocket) ----------
try:
    import asyncio, websockets
    async def ws_check():
        uri = f'ws://127.0.0.1:8080/api/events?token={disp_tok}&since=0'
        async with websockets.connect(uri, subprotocols=['lab-logistics-v1']) as ws:
            msg = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=10)
            return json.loads(msg)
    m = asyncio.run(ws_check())
    check('stream_realtime_events', 'type' in m and 'id' in m, json.dumps(m)[:120])
except Exception as e:
    check('stream_realtime_events', False, str(e)[:150])

# ---------- summary ----------
allops = ['accept_assignment','authenticate_user','cancel_journey','check_serviceability',
 'collect_and_seal_sample','configure_capacity','configure_laboratory_acceptance','confirm_handoff',
 'confirm_laboratory_receipt','create_collection_request','create_connection','create_location',
 'create_sample_type','create_user','decline_assignment','edit_active_plan','stream_realtime_events',
 'ingest_presealed_sample','initiate_handoff','list_role_work','merge_journeys','read_journey_plan',
 'read_operations_state','read_sample_lifecycle','read_sample_state','read_serviceability_snapshot',
 'read_user','record_handling_checkpoint','record_laboratory_exception','record_worker_location',
 'report_disruption','reroute_journey','search_audit_trail','select_active_role','set_connection_status',
 'set_location_function_status','set_location_status','set_worker_availability','split_journey',
 'read_ui_bootstrap','update_assignment_progress','update_location','update_sample_type',
 'update_user_access','system_readiness']
missing = [o for o in allops if o not in covered]
fails = [r for r in results if not r[1]]
print()
print(f'{len(results) - len(fails)}/{len(results)} checks passed; {len(covered)}/45 operations covered')
if missing:
    print('MISSING:', missing)
if fails:
    print('FAILURES:', fails)
sys.exit(1 if (missing or fails) else 0)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end verification of all 45 pinned contract operations."""
import json, time, uuid, datetime, urllib.request, urllib.error, sys

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
results = []
covered = set()

def now_iso():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def plus(h):
    return (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(hours=h)).isoformat()

def ikey():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or '{}'), {}
        except Exception:
            return e.code, {}, {}

def check(opid, ok, detail=''):
    covered.add(opid)
    results.append((opid, ok, detail))
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), opid, detail[:200])
    return ok

def op(opid, method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=200, field=None):
    st, resp, _ = raw(method, path, body, token)
    ok = st == expect and ('data' in resp or expect >= 400)
    if expect < 400:
        ok = st == expect and 'data' in resp
    check(opid, ok, f'HTTP {st}')
    if not ok:
        print('   resp:', json.dumps(resp)[:300])
        raise SystemExit(f'{opid} failed: {st} {json.dumps(resp)[:300]}')
    d = resp.get('data', {})
    return d

def login(username, password):
    st, resp, _ = raw('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {'username': username, 'password': password})
    assert st == 200, f'login {username} failed: {resp}'
    return resp['data']

SUF = str(int(time.time()))[-6:]

# ---------- 1. readiness & bootstrap ----------
st, resp, _ = raw('GET', '/ready')
check('system_readiness', st == 200 and resp.get('status') == 'ready', f'HTTP {st}')

st, resp, _ = raw('GET', '/api/ui/bootstrap')
check('read_ui_bootstrap', st == 200, f'HTTP {st}')

# ---------- 2. auth ----------
st, resp, _ = raw('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {'username': 'admin', 'password': 'wrong-pass'})
check('authenticate_user', st == 401 and 'error' in resp, 'invalid creds rejected')

admin = login('admin', 'admin123')
adm_tok = admin['sessionToken']
covered.add('authenticate_user')

d = op('read_user', 'GET', f"/api/read-user/{admin['userId']}", token=adm_tok)
d = op('select_active_role', 'POST', '/api/select-active-role', {'role': 'administrator'}, adm_tok)

# ---------- 3. network setup ----------
st = op('create_sample_type', 'POST', '/api/create-sample-type', {
    'name': f'VerifyType-{SUF}', 'qualifiedCollectorRequired': False,
    'containerType': 'standard', 'temperatureMinC': 2, 'temperatureMaxC': 25,
    'incompatibleSampleTypes': [], 'requiresCooledRoute': False, 'batchingAllowed': True}, adm_tok, 201)
type_id = st.get('sampleTypeId') or st.get('id')

op('update_sample_type', 'POST', '/api/update-sample-type', {
    'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'qualifiedCollectorRequired': False,
    'containerType': 'standard', 'temperatureMinC': 2, 'temperatureMaxC': 25,
    'incompatibleSampleTypes': [], 'requiresCooledRoute': False, 'batchingAllowed': True}, adm_tok)

cp = op('create_location', 'POST', '/api/create-location', {
    'name': f'Verify CP {SUF}', 'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9719, 'longitude': 77.6412},
    'active': True, 'functions': ['collection_point', 'transfer_point', 'hub'],
    'coverageKm': 6, 'handlingMinutes': 5}, adm_tok, 201)
cp_id = cp.get('locationId') or cp.get('id')
lab = op('create_location', 'POST', '/api/create-location', {
    'name': f'Verify Lab {SUF}', 'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9352, 'longitude': 77.6245},
    'active': True, 'functions': ['laboratory'], 'handlingMinutes': 0}, adm_tok, 201)
lab_id = lab.get('locationId') or lab.get('id')

op('update_location', 'POST', '/api/update-location', {
    'locationId': cp_id, 'name': f'Verify CP {SUF}',
    'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9719, 'longitude': 77.6412},
    'coverageKm': 6, 'handlingMinutes': 5,
    'functions': ['collection_point', 'transfer_point', 'hub']}, adm_tok)

conn = op('create_connection', 'POST', '/api/create-connection', {
    'fromLocationId': cp_id, 'toLocationId': lab_id,
    'travelMinutes': 20, 'costUnits': 1, 'active': True}, adm_tok, 201)
conn_id = conn.get('connectionId') or conn.get('id')

for rid in (cp_id, lab_id, conn_id):
    op('configure_capacity', 'POST', '/api/configure-capacity',
       {'resourceId': rid, 'capacityUnits': 20, 'cooledCapacityUnits': 10}, adm_tok)

op('configure_laboratory_acceptance', 'POST', '/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance',
   {'laboratoryId': lab_id, 'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'accepts': True}, adm_tok)

# ---------- 4. users ----------
def mkuser(uname, roles, loc=None):
    body = {'username': uname, 'initialPassword': 'pass1234', 'roles': roles,
            'active': True, 'fullName': uname}
    if loc:
        body['assignedLocationId'] = loc
    r = op('create_user', 'POST', '/api/create-user', body, adm_tok, 201)
    return r.get('userId') or r.get('id')

req_id = mkuser(f'vreq{SUF}', ['requester'])
coll_id = mkuser(f'vcoll{SUF}', ['collection_professional'])
cour_id = mkuser(f'vcour{SUF}', ['delivery_partner'])
node_id = mkuser(f'vnode{SUF}', ['node_handler'], cp_id)
labop_id = mkuser(f'vlabop{SUF}', ['laboratory_team'], lab_id)
disp_id = mkuser(f'vdisp{SUF}', ['dispatcher'])

op('update_user_access', 'POST', '/api/update-user-access', {
    'userId': cour_id, 'roles': ['delivery_partner'], 'active': True,
    'fullName': f'vcour{SUF}'}, adm_tok)

# disable all other workers so offers go to our fresh users
ops_state = op('read_operations_state', 'POST', '/api/read-operations-state', {}, adm_tok)
mine = {coll_id, cour_id, node_id, labop_id}
for w in ops_state.get('workers', []):
    wid = w.get('workerId') or w.get('userId') or w.get('id')
    if wid and wid not in mine:
        raw('POST', '/api/set-worker-availability',
            {'workerId': wid, 'available': False, 'capacityUnits': 0}, adm_tok)
for wid in mine:
    op('set_worker_availability', 'POST', '/api/set-worker-availability',
       {'workerId': wid, 'available': True, 'capacityUnits': 10}, adm_tok)

# toggle statuses off/on
op('set_location_status', 'POST', '/api/set-location-status', {'locationId': cp_id, 'active': False}, adm_tok)
op('set_location_status', 'POST', '/api/set-location-status', {'locationId': cp_id, 'active': True}, adm_tok)
op('set_location_function_status', 'POST', '/api/set-location-function-status',
   {'locationId': cp_id, 'function': 'hub', 'active': False}, adm_tok)
op('set_location_function_status', 'POST', '/api/set-location-function-status',
   {'locationId': cp_id, 'function': 'hub', 'active': True}, adm_tok)
op('set_connection_status', 'POST', '/api/set-connection-status', {'connectionId': conn_id, 'active': False}, adm_tok)
op('set_connection_status', 'POST', '/api/set-connection-status', {'connectionId': conn_id, 'active': True}, adm_tok)

# ---------- 5. requester: serviceability dry run + request ----------
req_tok = login(f'vreq{SUF}', 'pass1234')['sessionToken']
before = op('list_role_work', 'POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, req_tok)
n_before = len(before.get('pending', [])) + len(before.get('inProgress', [])) + len(before.get('completed', []))

svc = op('check_serviceability', 'POST', '/api/check-serviceability', {
    'origin': {'latitude': 12.9720, 'longitude': 77.6410}, 'originType': 'home',
    'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'requestedAt': now_iso(),
    'earliestCollectionAt': now_iso(), 'latestCollectionAt': plus(2),
    'deliveryDeadline': plus(8)}, req_tok)
check('check_serviceability.serviceable', svc.get('serviceable') is True, json.dumps(svc)[:150])

after = op('list_role_work', 'POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, req_tok)
n_after = len(after.get('pending', [])) + len(after.get('inProgress', [])) + len(after.get('completed', []))
check('check_serviceability.dry_run', n_after == n_before, f'work items {n_before} -> {n_after}')

def mkrequest():
    return op('create_collection_request', 'POST', '/api/create-collection-request', {
        'origin': {'latitude': 12.9720, 'longitude': 77.6410}, 'originType': 'home',
        'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'requestedAt': now_iso(),
        'earliestCollectionAt': now_iso(), 'latestCollectionAt': plus(2),
        'deliveryDeadline': plus(8), 'containerType': 'standard',
        'temperatureMinC': 2, 'temperatureMaxC': 25, 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, req_tok, 201)

r1 = mkrequest()
S1, J1 = r1['sampleId'], r1['journeyId']
check('create_collection_request.serviceable', r1.get('serviceability') == 'serviceable', S1)

# ---------- 6. collection flow ----------
coll_tok = login(f'vcoll{SUF}', 'pass1234')['sessionToken']
cour_tok = login(f'vcour{SUF}', 'pass1234')['sessionToken']
node_tok = login(f'vnode{SUF}', 'pass1234')['sessionToken']
labop_tok = login(f'vlabop{SUF}', 'pass1234')['sessionToken']
disp_tok = login(f'vdisp{SUF}', 'pass1234')['sessionToken']
op('select_active_role', 'POST', '/api/select-active-role', {'role': 'dispatcher'}, disp_tok)

def find_work(tok, sample_id, kind=None, statuses=('pending', 'inProgress')):
    d = op('list_role_work', 'POST', '/api/list-role-work', {}, tok)
    for sect in statuses:
        for it in d.get(sect, []):
            if it.get('sampleId') == sample_id and (kind is None or it.get('kind') == kind):
                return it
    return None

def wait_work(tok, sample_id, kind=None, secs=8):
    for _ in range(secs * 2):
        it = find_work(tok, sample_id, kind)
        if it:
            return it
        time.sleep(0.5)
    raise SystemExit(f'no {kind} work found for sample {sample_id}')

a_coll = wait_work(coll_tok, S1, 'collection')
# wrong user cannot accept
st, resp, _ = raw('POST', '/api/accept-assignment',
                  {'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, cour_tok)
check('accept_assignment.wrong_user', st in (403, 409), f'HTTP {st}')

# decline, then dispatcher re-offers via edit_active_plan
op('decline_assignment', 'POST', '/api/decline-assignment',
   {'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'reason': 'verify decline', 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, coll_tok)
plan = op('read_journey_plan', 'POST', '/api/read-journey-plan', {'journeyId': J1}, disp_tok)
op('edit_active_plan', 'POST', '/api/edit-active-plan', {
    'journeyId': J1, 'expectedPlanVersion': plan['planVersion'],
    'changeType': 'replace_worker',
    'changes': {'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'workerId': coll_id},
    'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, disp_tok, 201)

a_coll = wait_work(coll_tok, S1, 'collection')
op('accept_assignment', 'POST', '/api/accept-assignment',
   {'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, coll_tok)
op('record_worker_location', 'POST', '/api/record-worker-location', {
    'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'],
    'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9720, 'longitude': 77.6410},
    'sequence': 1, 'recordedAt': now_iso()}, coll_tok)
op('update_assignment_progress', 'POST', '/api/update-assignment-progress', {
    'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'status': 'at_pickup',
    'occurredAt': now_iso(), 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, coll_tok)
op('collect_and_seal_sample', 'POST', '/api/collect-and-seal-sample', {
    'sampleId': S1, 'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'collectedAt': now_iso(),
    'containerType': 'standard', 'observedTemperatureC': 20, 'idempotencyKey': ikey()}, coll_tok, 201)
op('record_handling_checkpoint', 'POST', '/api/record-handling-checkpoint', {
    'sampleId': S1, 'assignmentId': a_coll['assignmentId'], 'containerType': 'standard',

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end verification of all 45 pinned contract operations."""
import json, time, uuid, datetime, urllib.request, urllib.error, sys

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
results = []
covered = set()

def now_iso():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def plus(h):
    return (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(hours=h)).isoformat()

def ikey():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or '{}'), {}
        except Exception:
            return e.code, {}, {}

def check(opid, ok, detail=''):
    covered.add(opid)
    results.append((opid, ok, detail))
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), opid, detail[:200])
    return ok

def op(opid, method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=200, field=None):
    st, resp, _ = raw(method, path, body, token)
    ok = st == expect and ('data' in resp or expect >= 400)
    if expect < 400:
        ok = st == expect and 'data' in resp
    check(opid, ok, f'HTTP {st}')

def plus(h):

def ikey():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:

            req.add_header(k, v)

            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path

    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:

    if expect < 400:
        ok = st == expect and 'data' in resp

def now_iso():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def plus(h):
    return (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(hours=h)).isoformat()

def ikey():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or '{}'), {}
        except Exception:
            return e.code, {}, {}

def check(opid, ok, detail=''):
    covered.add(opid)
    results.append((opid, ok, detail))
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), opid, detail[:200])
    return ok

def op(opid, method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=200, field=None):
    st, resp, _ = raw(method, path, body, token)
    ok = st == expect and ('data' in resp or expect >= 400)
    if expect < 400:
        ok = st == expect and 'data' in resp
    check(opid, ok, f'HTTP {st}')
    if not ok:
        print('   resp:', json.dumps(resp)[:300])
        raise SystemExit(f'{opid} failed: {st} {json.dumps(resp)[:300]}')
    d = resp.get('data', {})
    return d

def login(username, password):

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""End-to-end verification of all 45 pinned contract operations."""
import json, time, uuid, datetime, urllib.request, urllib.error, sys

BASE = 'http://127.0.0.1:8080'
results = []
covered = set()

def now_iso():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def plus(h):
    return (datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) + datetime.timedelta(hours=h)).isoformat()

def ikey():
    return str(uuid.uuid4())

def raw(method, path, body=None, token=None, headers=None):
    url = BASE + path
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body is not None else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method)
    req.add_header('Content-Type', 'application/json')
    if token:
        req.add_header('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + token)
    if headers:
        for k, v in headers.items():
            req.add_header(k, v)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as r:
            return r.status, json.loads(r.read().decode() or '{}'), dict(r.headers)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        try:
            return e.code, json.loads(e.read().decode() or '{}'), {}
        except Exception:
            return e.code, {}, {}

def check(opid, ok, detail=''):
    covered.add(opid)
    results.append((opid, ok, detail))
    print(('PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'), opid, detail[:200])
    return ok

def op(opid, method, path, body=None, token=None, expect=200, field=None):
    st, resp, _ = raw(method, path, body, token)
    ok = st == expect and ('data' in resp or expect >= 400)
    if expect < 400:
        ok = st == expect and 'data' in resp
    check(opid, ok, f'HTTP {st}')
    if not ok:
        print('   resp:', json.dumps(resp)[:300])
        raise SystemExit(f'{opid} failed: {st} {json.dumps(resp)[:300]}')
    d = resp.get('data', {})
    return d

def login(username, password):
    st, resp, _ = raw('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {'username': username, 'password': password})
    assert st == 200, f'login {username} failed: {resp}'
    return resp['data']

SUF = str(int(time.time()))[-6:]

# ---------- 1. readiness & bootstrap ----------
st, resp, _ = raw('GET', '/ready')
check('system_readiness', st == 200 and resp.get('status') == 'ready', f'HTTP {st}')

# (called with auth below after admin login)

# ---------- 2. auth ----------
st, resp, _ = raw('POST', '/api/authenticate-user', {'username': 'admin', 'password': 'wrong-pass'})
check('authenticate_user', st == 401 and 'error' in resp, 'invalid creds rejected')

admin = login('admin', 'admin123')
adm_tok = admin['sessionToken']
covered.add('authenticate_user')
st, resp, _ = raw('GET', '/api/ui/bootstrap', token=adm_tok)
check('read_ui_bootstrap', st == 200, f'HTTP {st}')

d = op('read_user', 'GET', f"/api/read-user/{admin['userId']}", token=adm_tok)
d = op('select_active_role', 'POST', '/api/select-active-role', {'role': 'administrator'}, adm_tok)

# ---------- 3. network setup ----------
st = op('create_sample_type', 'POST', '/api/create-sample-type', {
    'name': f'VerifyType-{SUF}', 'qualifiedCollectorRequired': False,
    'containerType': 'standard', 'temperatureMinC': 2, 'temperatureMaxC': 25,
    'incompatibleSampleTypes': [], 'requiresCooledRoute': False, 'batchingAllowed': True}, adm_tok, 201)
type_id = st.get('sampleTypeId') or st.get('id')

op('update_sample_type', 'POST', '/api/update-sample-type', {
    'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'qualifiedCollectorRequired': False,
    'containerType': 'standard', 'temperatureMinC': 2, 'temperatureMaxC': 25,
    'incompatibleSampleTypes': [], 'requiresCooledRoute': False, 'batchingAllowed': True}, adm_tok, 201)

cp = op('create_location', 'POST', '/api/create-location', {
    'name': f'Verify CP {SUF}', 'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9719, 'longitude': 77.6412},
    'active': True, 'functions': ['collection_point', 'transfer_point', 'hub'],
    'coverageKm': 5, 'handlingMinutes': 5}, adm_tok, 201)
cp_id = cp.get('locationId') or cp.get('id')
lab = op('create_location', 'POST', '/api/create-location', {
    'name': f'Verify Lab {SUF}', 'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9352, 'longitude': 77.6245},
    'active': True, 'functions': ['laboratory'], 'handlingMinutes': 0}, adm_tok, 201)
lab_id = lab.get('locationId') or lab.get('id')

op('update_location', 'POST', '/api/update-location', {
    'locationId': cp_id, 'name': f'Verify CP {SUF}',
    'coordinate': {'latitude': 12.9719, 'longitude': 77.6412},
    'coverageKm': 5, 'handlingMinutes': 5,
    'functions': ['collection_point', 'transfer_point', 'hub']}, adm_tok, 201)

conn = op('create_connection', 'POST', '/api/create-connection', {
    'fromLocationId': cp_id, 'toLocationId': lab_id,
    'travelMinutes': 20, 'costUnits': 1, 'active': True}, adm_tok, 201)
conn_id = conn.get('connectionId') or conn.get('id')

for rid in (cp_id, lab_id, conn_id):
    op('configure_capacity', 'POST', '/api/configure-capacity',
       {'resourceId': rid, 'capacityUnits': 20, 'cooledCapacityUnits': 10}, adm_tok)

op('configure_laboratory_acceptance', 'POST', '/api/configure-laboratory-acceptance',
   {'laboratoryId': lab_id, 'sampleTypeId': type_id, 'accepts': True}, adm_tok)

op('update_user_access', 'POST', '/api/update-user-access', {

ops_state = op('read_operations_state', 'POST', '/api/read-operations-state', {}, adm_tok)
mine = {coll_id, cour_id, node_id, labop_id}
for w in ops_state.get('workers', []):
    wid = w.get('workerId') or w.get('userId') or w.get('id')
    if wid and wid not in mine:
        raw('POST', '/api/set-worker-availability',
            {'workerId': wid, 'available': False, 'capacityUnits': 0}, adm_tok)
for wid in mine:
    op('set_worker_availability', 'POST', '/api/set-worker-availability',
       {'workerId': wid, 'available': True, 'capacityUnits': 10}, adm_tok)
